summary: P0 admin slice — Routes CRUD + Schedule PATCH + Bulk-delete preview/execute + Terminal optional fields — fully verified. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (test_routes_and_bulk_delete.py). Frontend Playwright: admin login → routes tab → create KL-SG-TEST route with TBS pickup + GMC dropoff + enabled pairing → save succeeds → route appears in list → sched-route dropdown lists new route → schedules tab shows bulk-delete-panel + bulk-preview-btn → bookings/payments/admins/audit-log/feedback tabs all load. issues: Cosmetic React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Root cause is emergent instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> children — NOT this batch. Dropdown still functions (verified: 'KL-SG-TEST · Test Route KL to SG …' visible + selectable). Same warning noted in iteration_11.

critical_code_review_comments: Routes CRUD: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE all excluding _id via _serialize_route + {'_id':0} projections — clean.

Route validation (_validate_route_stops) correctly rejects (a) unknown terminal_ids, (b) pickup_id not in boarding_stops, (c) dropoff_id not in alighting_stops. Duplicate-code returns 400 with 'exists' in detail.

POST /api/admin/schedules with route_id validates from_terminal_id ∈ boarding_stops AND to_terminal_id ∈ alighting_stops — verified with KLS (not in route) → 400 with 'boarding' message. Same guard duplicated in bulk-create (server.py:2822-2831).

PATCH /api/admin/schedules/{id}: correctly filters None values, validates route_id existence AND that schedule's from/to fit route bounds, rebuilds layout_config on bus_type change, 400 on empty update, 404 on missing id. Returns doc without _id.

POST /api/admin/schedules/bulk-delete/preview with {} → 400 'At least one filter must be provided (safety guard).' — verified. With {unlinked_only:true} → 200 with matched/blocked/deletable numeric (all ints, deletable == matched-blocked).

POST /api/admin/schedules/bulk-delete (force=false) verified end-to-end: created 2 schedules under a test route, seeded 1 booking on one of them via pymongo, called bulk-delete → response {deleted:1, skipped:1} — schedule with booking survived. Preview showed matched=2, blocked=1, deletable=1. Force cleanup via {force:true}.
Bulk-delete zero-match branch returns {deleted:0, skipped:0} (200) — no 400/no accidental all-delete.
seat_locks are cleaned up alongside deleted schedules (server.py:3038) — good side-effect hygiene.

TerminalCreateBody accepts new optional fields (landmark_address, lat, lng, cts_code, is_pickup, is_dropoff). Values round-trip intact via GET /admin/terminals (verified with lat=3.14, lng=101.7, cts_code='CTS-TEST-01', is_pickup=True, is_dropoff=False).
Auth regression: admin login 200 + is_admin=true + no must_change_password; POST /auth/google/callback with fake code → 401 (behavior confirmed).
Frontend RoutesTab renders correct data-testids (pickup-picker, dropoff-picker, pickup-add-{code}, dropoff-add-{code}, pair-{from}-{to}, route-save-btn) — matches request spec exactly.
SchedulesTab bulk-delete-panel + bulk-preview-btn + bulk-filter-{route,from,to,start,end,unlinked} + bulk-force-toggle + bulk-execute-btn all present.
AddScheduleTab sched-route dropdown populates from /admin/routes on mount and includes newly-created route immediately after save (verified in Playwright).
